take: Per the Flyers' announcement, PHI placed right wing Travis Konecny on injured reserve and recalled defenseman Oliver Bonk from Lehigh Valley (AHL). Konecny played 16:49 a night and was on the first power-play unit; in the 5 games since he went out, Tyson Foerster has taken his spot beside Dvorak and Michkov, and Denver Barkey has moved up to 15:44 a night. PHI has been outplayed so far, with a 2-6-3 record and 39.6% of the expected goals (a measure of chance quality). Bonk, who averages 20:00, sees PHI hold a 17.49-point better share of expected goals with him on the ice.
